plugin.name: Starlight Meow
plugin.description: Brings N.E.K.O into Stellaris: build an in-game advisor voice pack from your own voice, and let the character comment live on the game you are playing by tailing game.log
panel.title: Neko Stellaris
panel.subtitle: Brings N.E.K.O into Stellaris: advisor voice pack, event bridge and live commentary.
panel.card.buildHint: A background job is running; progress refreshes every 2 seconds. Closing the panel does not stop it.
panel.card.logHint: All four counts should be 0. They are the keywords the release checklist greps for.
panel.log.unavailable.title: Cannot read error.log
panel.log.unavailable.body: Run the game once so it writes one.
panel.duplicate.bothEnabled.title: Both copies of the mod are enabled
panel.duplicate.bothPresent.title: Workshop and local copies both exist
panel.duplicate.bothEnabled.body: With both enabled the bridge's hooks are appended twice, so every event fires twice. Keep exactly one ticked in the launcher's playset.
panel.duplicate.bothPresent.body: Publishing to the Workshop makes the launcher migrate the local copy away. Until then, enable only one of them.
panel.empty.noMod.title: No voice pack in the game yet
panel.empty.noMod.body: Use Rebuild and install below to generate one.
panel.action.rebuildHint: Only the clips missing from cache are synthesized: one edited line is seconds, a voice change is minutes.
panel.action.probeHint: Synthesizes one line for real to verify the current voice and channel.
panel.action.uninstallHint: Only removes the directories this plugin created; other mods are never touched.
panel.confirm.uninstall.title: Uninstall the in-game mod?
panel.confirm.uninstall.body: Removes the advisor voice pack and event bridge this plugin installed. Cached lines in N.E.K.O are kept.
